name: Ancestral Temple
description: It is a sacred site where the people of Natlan once communicated with the Night Kingdom. In modern times, this temple is no longer in use, as the tribes have established a more stable connection with the Night Kingdom. However, it is still considered "holy ground", and is actively guarded by the Scions of the Canopy. According to Legba, only "experienced Couriers" who have passed three trials may enter.
